scope: Bounded owner-contact-only neighborhood enrichment of five existing approved grooming/beauty premises with a null neighborhood. No new business, service, tariff, duration, hours, address or coordinate change is proposed.

workflow.preflight: Local research/intake ledgers, current catalogue IDs and prior source holds were checked before the corresponding network calls, in separate calls. Contact sections were followed only on permitted owner sites. Existing stopped booking providers were not opened.
workflow.selection: The first three new contact checks supplied no explicit Sofia quarter. Two further bounded beauty checks also supplied only street addresses. Celine and MD Beauty were screened locally but not revisited because prior intake/recovery already recorded their missing or ambiguous quarter wording.
workflow.sourceAccess: Manual public owner-document reads through the web reader and the observed owner Contact anchors. On single-page sites the full document may be returned by the reader, but only the contact/address block is used as evidence in this task. No service/menu re-review, map link, booking provider, calendar, form submission, phone call, customer information or external geocoder was used.
workflow.copyright: Only short factual address excerpts are retained, fewer than 25 quoted words per owner source. No owner photographs, reviews, marketing prose or implied reuse licence are copied.

catalogueSnapshot.note: Read-only runtime count at the stated as-of time; other agents may add separate batches after this snapshot. All five IDs below were confirmed approved with neighborhood null.

held.observation: The Sofia contact block names the same hotel but a different boulevard wording and no street number or quarter. The explicitly named Vladislav Varnenchik quarter elsewhere in Contact belongs to Varna, not Sofia. Do not transfer it, infer a Sofia quarter, or silently rewrite the catalogue address.
held.nextEvidenceRequired: Exact Sofia premises quarter remains unverified. Root separately corroborated the named hotel address; no address or point change is justified by the wording difference alone.

rootAddressCorroboration.finding: The groomer still explicitly names ArtHotelSimona for Sofia. The hotel's own Contact explicitly publishes the existing catalogue street and number, and additionally places the hotel on the corner with Vazkresenie and Iv.Ev.Geshov. Thus the boulevard wording difference is not evidence of a moved salon or a wrong municipal point. That corner may explain the alternate description, but this is an inference, not a confirmed merchant typo.
rootAddressCorroboration.decision: Keep current merchant address and already bound official point unchanged; no new coordinates obtained or imported, no geocoder or Maps request. No exact Sofia quarter follows from either document. The unrelated Varna quarter stays excluded. Hotel booking forms, calls, prices and other services were not used or submitted.
